text.en:
The sum of fifteen thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the purchase of a parcel of land on the Island of Limasawa, Province
of Leyte, and the erection thereon of a public school to be denominated "Magellan Public School," as a
memorial to that great navigator who brought to these Islands the germ of the Western civilization, now
enjoyed by their inhabitants.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 10, 1922.
